minimum_basis.description: The weakest basis a fact may have to be served. observed serves only what Specimen saw or checked. A summary and a long form have no basis and are always served

default_library.description: The library a tag is looked up in first when it is in more than one, and the one components-list shows when no library is given and the pack has several

default_consumer.description: The consumer profile, from the space's consumers pack, that components-brief uses when a call names no consumer; a call that names one overrides it
